job.title: Project Planner
job.description:
Project Planner
Multi-site | Office & Site-Based | Primavera P6 / Project Controls

Amplifi Talent are partnering with an engineering services business to appoint a Project Planner to take ownership of project planning, programme control and performance analysis across live projects.

This represents an excellent opportunity for an experienced planning professional with a background in construction, industrial or mechanical and electrical projects to play a central role in coordinating programmes, resources and delivery.

The successful candidate will work closely with project, construction and commercial teams, providing clear insight into progress, identifying potential delays and ensuring that planning reflects the realities of site delivery.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to join a business where planning directly supports project delivery and commercial decision-making. Reporting to the Projects Manager, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to:

  • Develop and manage Primavera P6 baseline programmes, updates and recovery plans
  • Work closely with site teams to validate progress and coordinate construction sequencing
  • Identify constraints and assess their impact on project milestones
  • Develop labour forecasts, resource plans and productivity analysis
  • Support daily and weekly planning, including two-week and six-week look-ahead programmes
  • Integrate programme information with cost forecasts and earned value reporting
  • Support delay analysis, Extension of Time assessments and commercial claims
  • Provide clear reporting for project teams, clients and senior leadership
  • Improve planning systems, templates and reporting across projects

The role would suit somebody who enjoys combining detailed programme analysis with practical site engagement, working collaboratively to anticipate challenges and keep projects on track. Regular site engagement is required.

The Person

Key experience is likely to include:

  • Strong experience as a Project Planner within construction, industrial or mechanical and electrical environments
  • Advanced Primavera P6 capability, which is essential for the role
  • A strong understanding of construction sequencing, labour productivity and resource planning
  • Experience of earned value reporting, delay analysis and Extension of Time support
  • Advanced Excel skills, including resource histograms, S-curves and forecasting
  • Familiarity with job costing systems and site progress records
  • The confidence to challenge delivery assumptions constructively and support corrective action
  • Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly

The role may suit candidates currently operating within:

  • engineering and construction contractors
  • mechanical, electrical and plumbing contractors
  • industrial project delivery businesses
  • specialist planning and project controls consultancies

For further information, please contact Billy McCarthy, Amplifi Talent, in confidence.

job.title: Funding Manager
job.description:
Funding Manager
Belfast | UK & ROI Focus | Competitive Package

Amplifi Talent are partnering with a growing and highly ambitious advisory business to appoint a Funding Manager to lead and further develop its funding advisory capability across the UK and Republic of Ireland.

This represents a significant opportunity for an experienced funding professional to take ownership of an established and growing portfolio spanning European, UK and Irish funding programmes, supporting clients across a diverse range of sectors including innovation, infrastructure, sustainability, manufacturing and business growth.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting both strategic growth and technical delivery across complex funding applications, advisory engagements and client projects. 

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing advisory business operating across both Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland, with genuine ambition to further expand its funding and strategic advisory capability.The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:

  • Lead a high-value specialist advisory offering
  • Work across diverse and commercially significant projects
  • Support clients in identifying and securing funding opportunities
  • Develop long-term client relationships
  • Influence strategic growth across the wider business
  • Operate across UK, ROI and European funding landscapes
  • Build and shape a growing advisory function

The role has significant scope for progression and would suit somebody motivated by the opportunity to build capability, influence strategy and operate within a highly collaborative and growth-oriented environment.    

The Person

Key experience is likely to include:

  • Managing grant funding applications across UK, ROI and/or European programmes
  • Experience of programmes such as Horizon Europe, Innovate UK, Enterprise Ireland, InterTradeIreland or related funding mechanisms
  • Strong technical bid writing and funding application capability
  • Client advisory and stakeholder management experience
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and funding streams simultaneously
  • Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills

The role may suit candidates currently operating within:

  • accountancy practice / professional services environments
  • specialist funding consultancies
  • innovation advisory
  • economic development 

For further information, please contact Billy McCarthy, Amplifi Talent, in confidence.

job.title: Quantity Surveyor
job.description:
Quantity Surveyor
Portadown or Mallusk | Full-Time Permanent | Competitive Package

Amplifi Talent are partnering with an established mechanical and electrical contracting business to appoint a Quantity Surveyor to join its growing Projects Division.

Following continued growth and the award of a long-term local project, this represents an excellent opportunity to join an experienced commercial team and take responsibility for the commercial management of several live projects.

The successful candidate will report to the Commercial Director and work closely with Contract Managers, clients, design teams and the supply chain to support effective cost control, contract administration and project delivery.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing business offering a choice of office base in Portadown or Mallusk, alongside ongoing training and development. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:

  • Manage monthly valuations and track payment assessments
  • Prepare and manage variations, maintaining clear records of project changes
  • Support contractual notifications and administration across JCT and NEC contracts
  • Prepare subcontractor orders and coordinate with supply chain partners
  • Visit sites alongside Contract Managers to review progress, valuations and variations
  • Support monthly commercial reporting, cost analysis and forecasting
  • Build strong working relationships with project teams, clients and subcontractors
  • Contribute to the continued development of the quantity surveying function

The role offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals, with a personalised training plan to support career development. The wider benefits package includes a health cash plan, enhanced family leave, service-related holiday increases, employee recognition awards and wellbeing initiatives.

The Person

Key skills and experience are likely to include:

  • Strong numeracy and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships
  • Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel•
  • The ability to manage your own workload and meet strict deadlines
  • A collaborative approach and a commitment to continued professional development
  • A UK driving licence and willingness to undertake site visits

Experience within mechanical and electrical contracting, building services or related project environments would be advantageous, alongside knowledge of JCT and NEC contracts. Further training in contract notifications and administration will be available.

The role may suit candidates currently operating within:

  • mechanical and electrical contracting
  • building services businesses
  • main contractors or specialist subcontractors
  • quantity surveying and commercial project teams

For further information, please contact Billy McCarthy, Amplifi Talent, in confidence.
